products.pds_prepared_or_version_date: Date of Preparation: 7 February 2024; Version: NP_DOM_07_07FEB2024
products.geographic_scope: Australia only (domestic travel). No cover for cruises in Australian waters under this plan.
products.eligibility_rules: Available only to residents of Australia. Policy ends on return home or at 11:59pm AET on the return date. Plan cannot be purchased more than 18 months prior to travel. Accompanying children travel for no additional premium. There is no cover for cruises in Australian waters. You may extend a policy up to a maximum of 12 months from the original departure date if eligible.
products.age_eligibility_notes: No age limit on this plan. Accompanying children must be under 25 and working less than 30 hours per week.

waiting_period_rules.section_or_benefit: All benefits (when policy purchased after travel has started)
waiting_period_rules.rule: 72-hour waiting period applies from Certificate of Insurance issue before cover starts.
waiting_period_rules.exceptions: If after the trip departure date and before the end of the 72 hours you suffer an injury due to an accident, Medical evacuation and repatriation cover begins from the time of the accident for that injury.

waiting_period_rules.section_or_benefit: Cancellation/Coronavirus (if departure date set >72 hours after COI while already travelling)
waiting_period_rules.rule: Cover for Cancellation or holiday deferment costs and Coronavirus travel costs events 1–5 begins only after the 72-hour waiting period.

products.policy_cancellation_refund_terms: Full refund within 21-day cooling-off if you haven’t started your trip, made a claim or intend to claim. Outside cooling-off, a pro‑rata refund for the unused period may be provided at the insurer’s discretion if travel hasn’t started and no claim has been or will be made.
products.excess_options: Standard policy excess $100 per claim unless a benefit states ‘No excess applies’. An additional excess may apply to specified medical conditions and will be shown on the Certificate of Insurance (cannot be removed).

excess_rules.notes: No excess applies where specifically stated for certain benefits (e.g., Travel delay, Emergency expenses to avoid disaster, Early return home, Return of rental vehicle, Emergency luggage, Hiring replacement golf/surf equipment, Accidental death, and Snow sports option benefits).

excess_rules.amount: Additional excess as advised in writing
excess_rules.basis: each occurrence related to the specified condition
excess_rules.notes: Shown on Certificate of Insurance; cannot be removed or changed.

products.emergency_medical_limit: Nil (no medical, hospital, dental or ambulance expenses in Australia)
products.cancellation_cover_limit: Chosen limit per policy (shared across all insured persons)
products.luggage_single_item_limit: $500 general single item limit; $1,000 personal computer/camera/video; $1,000 smartphone
products.rental_vehicle_excess_limit: $5,000 per policy (optional additional cover available in $1,000 units up to an extra $5,000)
products.personal_accident_limit: $10,000 Accidental death (accompanying children sub-limit $1,000 per child)
products.covid_cover_summary: COVID-19 cover for cancellation/rearrangement if you or travelling party diagnosed; close relative/business partner in Australia hospitalised or dies; leave cancellation for healthcare/residential care/law enforcement workers; tour guide diagnosis; accommodation staff shortages/closure for cleaning; denied boarding due to suspected infection; compulsory quarantine due to diagnosis or confirmed close contact; additional childcare/pet care. No cover for government-wide quarantine, border closures, change of mind, known events, failure to follow official guidelines, or expenses after returning home.

optional_add_ons.name: Cancellation option (Chosen limit)
optional_add_ons.details: You must choose a cancellation limit at purchase; appears on Certificate of Insurance.

optional_add_ons.name: Snow sports cover option
optional_add_ons.details: Required for any claim arising from participation in snow sports; adds specific benefits (Ski lift passes $300; Ski run closure $100/day up to $500; Hire replacement snow equipment $300).

optional_add_ons.name: Additional rental vehicle insurance excess option
optional_add_ons.details: Increase rental vehicle excess cover in $1,000 units, up to an additional $5,000.

optional_add_ons.name: Specified items option
optional_add_ons.details: Specify high-value items above item limit. Max $4,000 per item, $10,000 total. No depreciation on specified items.

optional_add_ons.name: Specified medical conditions option
optional_add_ons.details: Apply and pay additional premium/excess if approved to cover existing medical conditions not automatically covered.

coverage_benefits.notes: Per policy shared across all travellers on the COI.

coverage_benefits.benefit: Emergency travel arrangements and accommodation expenses

coverage_benefits.notes: No cover for medical, hospital, dental or ambulance expenses in Australia.

coverage_benefits.conditions: Each delayed leg must be delayed at least 6 hours.

coverage_benefits.benefit: Missed connection – flight delay within Australia
coverage_benefits.conditions: Original connection must allow at least 90 minutes published connecting time.

coverage_benefits.benefit: Hiring replacement golf and surf equipment
Fraudulent use of credit or debit cards

coverage_benefits.summary: Specified COVID-19 cancellation/disruption events only; no border-closure/government-wide quarantine cover.

sub_limits.parent_benefit: Emergency travel arrangements and accommodation expenses
Emergency travel arrangements and accommodation expenses

sub_limits.amount: Limit doubles if luggage still missing after 72 hours

products.limit_basis_notes: Unless stated otherwise, limits apply per adult traveller and are not increased for accompanying children. The Cancellation ‘Chosen limit’ is a per-policy limit shared by all listed travellers. A policy premium is charged per adult; accompanying children are covered at no extra premium.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: Over 40 conditions are automatically covered when criteria are met. Other existing medical conditions are not covered unless you complete medical screening at purchase and nib agrees in writing to cover them as specified medical conditions for an additional premium/excess. Claims arising from existing medical conditions of you/your travelling party/non-travelling close relative/business partner are otherwise excluded.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Pregnancy is not treated as an existing medical condition. Cover applies for pregnancy-related illness/events occurring up to the end of the 26th week, provided the illness first developed unexpectedly after buying the policy. No cover for childbirth/newborn care and no cover for pregnancy-related existing conditions unless approved as a specified condition (Australian Travel Plan only).
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Cancellation cover may apply for illness/injury/death of a close relative or business partner resident in Australia or New Zealand, subject to hospitalisation/death confirmation. Claims arising from their existing medical conditions are excluded.

optional_activity_cover.activity: Snow sports (skiing, snowboarding, snowmobiling, tobogganing, cross‑country/telemark)
optional_activity_cover.required_add_on: Snow sports cover option must be purchased for any claim arising from participation in snow sports.

excluded_activities.exclusion: Motorcycle/moped >250cc, riding without helmet, or without valid unrestricted motorcycle licence (AUS-valid)
Scuba diving without open water licence or not under licensed instruction
Mountaineering using support ropes, paragliding, rock climbing, abseiling, BASE jumping, running with the bulls, potholing
Activities on snow or ice other than snow sports with Snow sports option

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Cover applies only to the rental vehicle insurance excess (or repair cost if lower). Vehicle must be a 4‑wheeled vehicle <4.5t GVM, hired from a registered rental company under a written agreement; you must be a nominated driver; the rental must have valid comprehensive insurance; excludes administration or loss-of-use fees and any event not covered by the rental’s comprehensive insurance; no liability cover for use of a vehicle.
products.luggage_conditions: Unattended property exclusion applies. Valuables (personal computers, smartphones, communication/photographic or electronic equipment, jewellery, watches) are not covered if left in a motor vehicle/motorhome/caravan. Items left in a vehicle must be concealed, during daylight hours only, in a locked vehicle with forced entry; not covered if left between sunset and sunrise, unconcealed, or in an unlocked vehicle. No cover for items left in a tent. No cover for valuables checked-in as luggage. Locked storage facility claims require proof of forced entry and items must not be stored for more than 48 hours. Proof of ownership/value required. Depreciation applies to non-specified items per published schedule.

depreciation_rules.category: Camping, sporting and leisure equipment (not leisure clothing), musical instruments
Clothing, footwear, personal effects, luggage, prescription/sunglasses, costume jewellery, books
Personal computer, communication or photographic equipment, electronic equipment, mobile/smart phones, CDs, DVDs
Toiletries including skin care, makeup, perfume, medication

general_exclusions.name: Medical expenses in Australia
general_exclusions.description: No cover for any medical, hospital or dental expenses incurred in Australia.

general_exclusions.name: Existing medical conditions
general_exclusions.description: Claims arising from existing medical conditions of you, travelling party, non-travelling close relative or business partner excluded (unless your specified/automatically covered conditions).

general_exclusions.name: Pregnancy beyond 26 weeks/birth
general_exclusions.description: No cover for pregnancy-related illness after 26 weeks or expenses related to birth/newborn care.

general_exclusions.name: Epidemic/pandemic/general exclusions
general_exclusions.description: Loss arising from epidemic, pandemic or WHO PHEIC excluded except for Medical evacuation and repatriation and Coronavirus travel costs sections.

general_exclusions.name: War/terrorism
general_exclusions.description: War and related perils excluded; terrorism excluded except specified sections (Emergency expenses to avoid disaster, Emergency accommodation due to terrorism, Luggage, and in-country repatriation with medical escort if carrier requires).

general_exclusions.name: Do Not Travel advice
general_exclusions.description: No cover for travelling to or remaining in a country/region subject to ‘Do not travel’ advisory from Smartraveller.

general_exclusions.name: Financial default
general_exclusions.description: Loss from financial default of any person/company/organisation involved in travel arrangements excluded.

general_exclusions.name: Government actions/sanctions
general_exclusions.description: Loss from government intervention/prohibition/regulation or sanctions restrictions excluded (subject to Coronavirus travel costs provisions).

benefit_exclusions.exclusion: No cover where also claimed under another section; minimum 6-hour threshold applies.

benefit_exclusions.benefit: Missed connection – flight delay within Australia
benefit_exclusions.exclusion: No cover if original connection was booked with less than 90 minutes connecting time; no double claiming.
No additional travel above originally booked fare class unless medically justified and approved; prior consent required for expenses over $2,000 for early return/repatriation.
Not a substitute for rental insurance; no cover for liability, admin or loss of use fees; event must be covered by rental’s comprehensive insurance.
Multiple unattended property/vehicle/valuables and excluded items conditions apply (e.g., valuables in vehicles, tents, checked-in valuables, trade items).

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover for travel to/within regions with Smartraveller ‘Do not travel’ advice; sanctions/UN/EU/UK/US restrictions apply; no cover where provision would expose insurer/reinsurer to sanctions.
products.claims_process_summary: Prevent further loss; report theft/damage to police/carrier/hotel and obtain documentation; submit claim as soon as possible; provide medical reports, receipts, tickets, rental agreements and other evidence requested; claims service standard is a decision within 10 working days of receiving all information. Claims paid in AUD at the exchange rate at time of loss.
products.emergency_assistance_details: nib International Assistance 24/7: Within Australia 1300 555 019; Outside Australia +61 3 8523 2800; Email travelassist@nib.com.au
products.premium_factors: Trip length; time between purchase date and departure date; destination; travel plan chosen; traveller age; add-ons/options selected (cancellation limit, snow sports, rental vehicle excess increase, specified items, specified medical conditions).

data._document_notes: The Australian Travel Plan does not state a single maximum trip duration; eligibility rules allow extensions up to 12 months from the original departure date, but a firm maximum trip length is not explicitly printed, so maximum_trip_duration_days is left null for that plan. The Cancellation and Additional Expenses Plan explicitly excludes trips greater than 12 months, so 365 days is recorded as the maximum duration. Domestic medical/hospital/dental expenses are excluded under both plans; only evacuation/repatriation is covered under the Australian Travel Plan.
